name: NeuraDeer – AI Chatbot for WordPress & WooCommerce
author: davx2142

sections.description:
NeuraDeer Connector links your WordPress website, blog or WooCommerce shop to your NeuraDeer account, so you can run an AI chatbot on your site without touching code.

It works for any WordPress site – a content website or blog gets its own AI chatbot with a custom personality (no products required), and WooCommerce shops additionally get product import and real-time catalog sync.

What you can do from the WordPress admin:

  • Dashboard: your current plan, message/product/token usage, and whether the widget and your shop are connected – all on one screen, refreshed on demand.
  • Connect your site with a short pairing code you generate in your NeuraDeer account (or create a new account, verified by an emailed 2FA code).
  • Bot personality (Settings): choose a persona and tone, add custom instructions and quick replies – for websites, blogs and shops alike. Each field explains when it is useful.
  • Webshop (WooCommerce only, optional): connect WooCommerce with one click – the plugin creates a read-only REST API key for you – then import your catalog and turn on real-time sync. Imported products are listed in a sortable, searchable table you can edit or clean up.
  • Learning: scan a page URL, upload a PDF/TXT/CSV/DOCX document, and work through the questions your bot could not answer – each one marked answered or not, searchable and sortable. Everything you teach it is listed in a knowledge base you can edit or clean up later.
  • Widget: place the chat widget in your site footer with one click, and customize the image, color, position, icon, welcome message and auto-open.
  • Statistics: message counts and token usage at a glance, and a plan comparison with a link to your online NeuraDeer profile for billing.
  • Multilingual admin UI: Hungarian, English and German, switchable in the plugin.

The plugin only orchestrates these actions – all AI processing happens on the NeuraDeer service.

External services

This plugin connects to the NeuraDeer service (https://neuradeer.com) to provide the AI chatbot. It is required for the plugin to function.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you connect / register: your site URL, and – only when creating a new account from the plugin – the name, email address, password and shop name you enter in the registration form.
  • When you import products or enable real-time sync (WooCommerce only): product data (name, description, price, stock status, category, image URL, product URL) is sent to NeuraDeer for indexing.
  • When you use Learning: the page URL you scan, or the document file you upload, is sent to NeuraDeer to be added to your knowledge base.
  • When you save bot/widget settings: the settings values you enter are sent to NeuraDeer.
  • On every request: your NeuraDeer public key and a security key generated by the plugin are sent as request headers to authenticate.
  • When the chat widget runs on your public pages: the widget loads a script from NeuraDeer and end-user chat messages are processed by the NeuraDeer service.

No data is sent until you connect the plugin to a NeuraDeer account. All requests go to https://neuradeer.com.

  • Terms of Service: https://neuradeer.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://neuradeer.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the neuradeer-connector folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the NeuraDeer menu in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. On the Profile tab, paste your NeuraDeer public key and click Connect – or create a new account directly from the plugin.
  5. Set up your bot’s personality on the Settings tab, then place the widget on the Widget tab.
sections.faq:
Do I need a NeuraDeer account?

Yes. The plugin is a connector to the NeuraDeer AI chatbot service. You can create an account for free directly from the plugin’s Profile tab; it is confirmed with a verification code sent to your email.

Does it require WooCommerce?

No. Any WordPress site or blog can run a chatbot with a custom personality. WooCommerce is only needed if you want to import products and use real-time catalog sync.

What data is sent to NeuraDeer?

See the “External services” section above for the full list.

In which languages is the admin interface available?

Hungarian, English and German, switchable inside the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2

  • Improved: clearer plugin name and description on the plugin directory listing – functionality is unchanged.

1.3.1

  • Fixed: the language switcher now actually translates the plugin – complete Hungarian and German translations are bundled, covering every menu, description, hint and guide (previously everything stayed English).

1.3.0

  • New: step-by-step onboarding guide on the Profile tab – one path if you already have a NeuraDeer account (where to find the pairing code), another if you are registering from the plugin (connected automatically, no code needed).
  • New: new accounts start on the Free plan; the plan band on the Dashboard and Profile tabs shows how many days are left and offers a one-click “Switch to Main” button.
  • New: plan comparison cards at the bottom of the Dashboard tab too, so you can upgrade from there.
  • New: prices are shown in EUR next to HUF, using the current ECB exchange rate, so international users always know what they pay.
  • Improved: if automatic connection fails right after registration, the plugin now explains that your account was created and shows the pairing-code path with a direct link to the NeuraDeer admin.

1.2.0

  • New: connect your site with a short pairing code generated in your NeuraDeer account, instead of copying a long key.
  • New: open your NeuraDeer profile straight from WordPress – the button signs you in with a single-use link that expires in 60 seconds.
  • New: upload the chat image (the avatar shown in the chat header) directly from the Widget tab.
  • New: the questions your bot could not answer are now a searchable, sortable, paginated list, each marked answered or not, with the answer visible and editable afterwards.
  • New: the knowledge base is now a paginated, searchable list where entries can be edited or deleted.
  • New: each plan now shows what it includes, next to the message and product limits.
  • Security: your subscription is bound to the domain it was activated on, so the connection cannot be moved to another site without disconnecting first. Disconnecting also revokes the WooCommerce API key the plugin created.

1.1.0

  • New: Dashboard tab showing your plan, message, product and token usage, plus widget and webshop status, with one-click widget placement.
  • New: one-click WooCommerce connection. The plugin generates a read-only WooCommerce REST API key on your site and hands it to NeuraDeer, so you no longer have to create and copy keys by hand. Manual entry is still available.
  • New: plan comparison on the Profile tab, and a link to your online NeuraDeer profile for billing and detailed analytics.
  • New: the Products list is now a paginated table (20 rows per page) with column sorting, search, inline editing and deletion.
  • Improved: Profile now shows live message, product and token usage with a Refresh button instead of a static counter.
  • Security: the WooCommerce API key created by the plugin has read-only permission and is revoked automatically when you disconnect from NeuraDeer.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
